profile_text.body:
Murf is an AI voice and conversational agent platform that describes itself as trusted by 10 million or more developers, businesses, and creators. The company offers a suite of voice-focused products including a text-to-speech API, an AI voiceover generator, and an AI dubbing tool for localizing video content into multiple languages while preserving the original voice and tone. Its platform supports more than 35 languages, including English, German, French, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, and others.

Murf's core AI products include two text-to-speech models. Falcon is described as the company's lowest-latency model, built for real-time conversational applications and using a proprietary neural architecture the company says leads on a metric it calls the Voice Quality Metric. Gen2 is positioned as a customization-first model for voiceover production, with controls for tone, pacing, and emphasis. Murf also offers what it calls Murf Agents, conversational AI agents designed for inbound and outbound calls and chat, with the ability to escalate interactions to a human when needed.

The site's held facts record Murf's primary product as Murf.ai, categorized under voice and audio with a note of voice synthesis. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
